status: x-y-time-only feasibility preflight frozen before movement-state-conditioned vertical outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
question: Can a movement-intensity state defined only from horizontal displacement and time be conditioned on without collapsing evaluable support in the five comparative panels?

state_construction.input: x-y-time only; no vertical values enter state assignment or feasibility selection
state_construction.projection: reuse each frozen panel/cohort projection from the existing paper pipeline
state_construction.step_speed: Euclidean horizontal distance between consecutive fixes within the same frozen session divided by elapsed seconds
state_construction.invalid_steps: first fix, non-positive dt, or dt above candidate cap receive no movement state
state_construction.thresholds: Within each frozen cohort, pool all valid step speeds from retained sessions and cut at empirical equal-frequency quantiles for the candidate number of states.
state_construction.state_label: quantile bin of horizontal step speed within cohort

feasibility.target_support: A target event is structurally supported when its 5-km cell × movement-state pair occurs in at least one other session of the same individual and in at least one retained session of at least one other individual in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one retained target session with >=50 supported target events
feasibility.selection_rule: Choose the first candidate in priority order for which every primary panel retains at least 70% of its frozen centered-shape evaluable individuals and at least 5 individuals. If none passes, do not open the movement-state-conditioned vertical outcome.

planned_mechanism_test_if_feasible.hypothesis_A: behavioural-mixture individuality: individual vertical identity is largely induced by repeatable differences in movement-state composition
planned_mechanism_test_if_feasible.hypothesis_B: within-state individuality: individual vertical identity persists after conditioning on the same broad movement-intensity state
planned_mechanism_test_if_feasible.primary_test: Using the selected preflight definition, recompute centered vertical self-vs-other prediction conditional on 5-km cell × movement state and calibrate the complete estimator with the same whole-session label-permutation scheme already frozen for each panel.
planned_mechanism_test_if_feasible.panel_support_rule: calibrated observed-minus-null-mean identity > 0 and one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05
planned_mechanism_test_if_feasible.interpretation: Persistence supports within-state individuality relative to this x-y-time movement-state proxy. Loss of identity is consistent with behavioural-mixture sufficiency but can also reflect support/power loss, so attrition and null width must be reported.

stop_rule: Do not change candidate order, 70% retention rule, >=5-individual floor, 50-event target support, speed definition, quantile thresholds, or 5-km cell × state support after preflight output is opened.
Do not inspect vertical outcome while selecting the state definition.
If no candidate passes the preflight, stop this mechanism family rather than loosening thresholds.
This extension remains outside the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
